description: Anonymously create a pseudonym account for a did:plc whose genesis operation is already in PLC.

main.description: Verifies the PLC genesis operation, spends a blind creation token and consumes a reserved signing key. No email, password or audit trail.

errors.name: InvalidGenesis
errors.description: The PLC genesis operation is missing or not acceptable to this PDS.

errors.name: SigningKeyNotReserved
errors.description: The signing key was not reserved at this PDS.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The creation token is missing or invalid.

errors.name: TokenSpent
errors.description: The creation token was already used.

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.description: An account with this DID or handle already exists.
